02 / HOW WE CAN HELP

The right assessment.
For your situation.

From an on-site investigation to a remote conversation, start with the service that fits your needs.

01 / ON SITE

Field
assessments

A hands-on evaluation of the indoor environment and building conditions at your property.

Best for: Homes with suspected mold, water damage, odors, or unexplained health concerns.

Pricing: From $195 for a focused review; $1,295 for a whole-home assessment. Travel quoted by location.

What’s included +
  • Pre-visit conversation about your history and concerns
  • On-site inspection of the building, HVAC, and problem areas
  • Sampling and instrument readings as the situation calls for
  • Lab analysis and a written findings report
  • Results call with Joe and recommended next steps
Request a field assessment ↗
02 / REMOTE

Virtual
assessments

Connect with Joe remotely to talk through your concerns, review what you’re seeing, and decide on the right next step.

Best for: Early questions, clients outside the travel area, or reviewing prior test results.

Pricing: Quoted at booking.

What’s included +
  • Video consultation with Joe
  • Review of photos, history, and any existing reports
  • Guidance on whether on-site testing is needed
  • Written summary of recommendations
Book a virtual assessment ↗
03 / PROPERTY DECISIONS

Sales & rental
assessments

Environmental insight before you buy, sell, or sign a lease, so you understand a property before you commit.

Best for: Buyers, renters, and sellers, including people with heightened sensitivity to indoor conditions.

Pricing: Based on property size and location.

What’s included +

05 / BEFORE YOUR ASSESSMENT

A little preparation
means better results.

Your full checklist is emailed after booking and depends on your assessment. Here’s what most clients can expect.

  • Keep windows and exterior doors closed beforehandWe’ll confirm how long for your assessment.
  • Hold off on deep cleaning, painting, or air purifiersThey can mask the conditions we need to measure.
  • Gather your home’s historyLeaks, water damage, renovations, and any past remediation.
  • Note your concernsWhich rooms, what you notice, and when it seems worse.
  • Share any earlier test results or reports
  • Make sure the attic, crawlspace, basement, and HVAC are accessible

06 / MEET YOUR CONSULTANT

Joseph P.
Reiss Jr.

Over 30 years connecting construction, environmental investigation, and indoor air quality.

Joe is an Indoor Environmental Professional whose work focuses on complex and abnormal indoor conditions. He combines hands-on expertise with a science-based investigative approach to help clients understand hidden environmental concerns.

Through JP Reiss Environmental Group, he serves clients across the East Coast and beyond, with a focus on root causes, practical solutions, and environmental awareness.

Professional credentials +
  • Certified Indoor Environmental Consultant (CIEC)
  • Certified Microbial Investigator (CMI)
  • New York State-licensed Mold Assessor
  • NYSDOL Licensed Mold Assessment Contractor
  • Additional accreditation through CESB

09 / QUESTIONS

Common
questions.

Don’t see yours? Ask on your intro call.

My doctor thinks my home may be affecting my health. Is this for me? +

Yes. Many of Joe’s clients come to him on a practitioner’s recommendation. He specializes in complex indoor conditions and works with people who are highly sensitive to their environment.

What’s the difference between a field and a virtual assessment? +

A field assessment is an on-site investigation with sampling and lab analysis. A virtual assessment is a remote consultation, often the right first step or an option if you’re outside the travel area.

How is pricing determined? +

By the type of assessment, the scope of the property, and travel. You’ll receive the full price before anything is scheduled.

Do you travel outside the East Coast? +

Yes, for the right project. Out-of-region travel is quoted separately.

Do you do remediation? +

Joe’s role is assessment and guidance. When remediation is needed, he can recommend providers and perform post-remediation testing.

How long until I get results? +

We’ll give you a timeline when your assessment is booked and let you know as soon as lab results arrive.

How do I pay? +

You’ll receive an itemized invoice by email or text with a secure link to pay online.
